versions.content: Name StorageCondition Comment Provides the capability to set a storage condition if at least one storage condition is configured. One port of this interface type is provided per storage condition by the Dem Service Component. It has StorageConditionId as a port-defined argument. IsService true Variation – 0 E_OK Operation successful Possible Errors 1 E_NOT_OK Operation failed Operation SetStorageCondition Comment – Variation – ConditionFulfilled Type boolean Direction IN Comment This parameter specifies whether the enable condition assigned to the Enable ConditionID is fulfilled (TRUE) or not fulfilled (FALSE). Parameters Variation – Possible Errors E_OK E_NOT_OK
